option.name: --add-subgids
tip: Add a range of subordinate gids to the user's account.

option.name: --add-subuids
tip: Add a range of subordinate uids to the user's account.

option.name: --append
tip: Append the user to the supplemental GROUPS mentioned by the -G option without removing the user from other groups.

option.name: --badname
tip: Allow names that do not conform to standards. (deprecated)

option.name: --comment
tip: New value of the GECOS field.

option.name: --del-subgids
tip: Remove a range of subordinate gids from the user's account.

option.name: --del-subuids
tip: Remove a range of subordinate uids from the user's account.

option.name: --expiredate
tip: Set account expiration date to EXPIRE_DATE.

option.name: --gid
tip: Force use GROUP as new primary group.

option.name: --groups
tip: New list of supplementary GROUPS.

option.name: --help
tip: Display help message and exit.

option.name: --home
tip: New home directory for the user account.

option.name: --inactive
tip: Set password inactive after expiration to INACTIVE.

option.name: --lock
tip: Lock the user account.

option.name: --login
tip: New value of the login name.

option.name: --move-home
tip: Move contents of the home directory to the new location (use only with -d).

option.name: --non-unique
tip: Allow using duplicate (non-unique) UID.

option.name: --password
tip: Use encrypted password for the new password.

option.name: --prefix
tip: Apply changes to configuration files under the root filesystem found under PREFIX_DIR.
This option does not chroot and is intended for preparing a cross-compilation target.

option.name: --remove
tip: Remove the user from only the supplemental GROUPS mentioned by the -G option without removing the user from other groups.

option.name: --root
tip: Apply changes in the CHROOT_DIR directory and use the configuration files from the CHROOT_DIR directory.
Only absolute paths are supported.

option.name: --selinux-range
tip: New SELinux MLS range for the user account.

option.name: --selinux-user
tip: New SELinux user mapping for the user account.

option.name: --shell
tip: New login shell for the user account.

option.name: --uid
tip: New UID for the user account.

option.name: --unlock
tip: Unlock the user account.
